goal: The top 30 Snap parts and the top 30 Pro parts, every one verified by the generator gate.
criteria: Covers every connection type and size class, so the standard is exercised end to end.
Useful on a scanned toy first: add-ons, capsules and mounts weigh more than plain bricks, because that is the product.
Prints without supports and passes the fit gate; a part that cannot is replaced, not forced.
Reused by other parts and by the AI design loop; family-built so each new variant is one catalog row.
Original designs only. No third-party names.
rules: Snap grids are at least 2x2: a 1xN part has no tubes, so nothing holds its studs.
Skins are game-only and are not counted.
Every Large part must clear the small-parts cylinder.

Attach slots: character add-ons and vehicle parts carry attach.kind (character or vehicle), attach.slots, and attach.front: the part's local -y or +y faces the toy's front, or the part is symmetric. Slot names: character head, back, body, top, tail; vehicle front, rear, hood, roof, wheels; robot legs, torso, arms, head, back.

waves.name: Foundation
waves.scope: Done: catalog-driven registration (one catalog row per part), the block, tile, slope and dome families, Pro checks I4 to I6 and pin-and-bore mating in the validator, all proven on fixtures. The round block was replaced by a dome because a round outline cannot carry studs on the lattice.

waves.name: Snap base and shape blocks
waves.scope: 11 parts, all from the block, tile, slope and dome families on the existing foot and tube code.

waves.name: Pro core
waves.scope: 13 parts: five straight beams, pins, shafts and bushings. First Pro fit windows. Pro rows need a `stat` before they register.

waves.name: Snap characters, capsules and small mount
waves.scope: 10 parts, mostly bespoke shapes that need a visual review as well as the gate.

waves.name: Pro gears, corner beams, mount and adapter
waves.scope: 13 parts: involute gears on module 2.5, rack, worm, L/T/angled beams, the Pro Forge Mount and the Snap-to-Pro adapter.

waves.name: Pro joints and wheels
waves.scope: 4 parts: two wheels, a hinge, a cross connector.

waves.name: Forge Club Month 1: Racer
waves.scope: Six car add-ons (Spoiler, Bull Bar, Hood Scoop, Twin Exhaust, Light Bar, Roof Rack) and a wheel set (Axle Block, Racer Wheel, Racer Axle), Snap Small on 1 and 2 stud footprints, built print-first. The first seeded Forge Club set.

waves.name: Forge Club Month 2: Critters
waves.scope: A Small Waddle Tail, so every character slot has a part in the size on offer, and the Critters set: Pointy Ears, Bumper Horns, Cloud Wings, Pebble Armor Shell, Waddle Tail and Bounce Capsule.

waves.name: Snap robots: Bolt
waves.scope: The first Snap robot: one part for each of the five robot slots (legs, torso, arms, head, back), stacking on studs, fixed pose, ages 3+. Four more parts per slot follow.

waves.name: Kip wardrobe and modular TU vehicles
waves.scope: 59 parts (49 Snap Small, 10 Pro): eleven Wave 9 character and robot heads across 4 categories (4 smooth organic humanoid heads that share one universal face zone, wig vault and hat cavity: Soft Youth (neutral), Sweet Heart (feminine), Heroic Jaw (masculine) and Jumbo Vinyl, all listed in Kip-Demo.html; 1 Mecha Scout robot head pairing with Kip Classic & Bolt Robot; 3 animal critter heads: Fox, Bear, Whisker Cat; 3 creature heads: Drake Dragon, Starling Alien, Yeti Imp) with 2x1 crown buds, three universal interchangeable 1 TU facial inserts (3D Nose & Smile Face Insert, 3D Button Eyes & Nose Face Insert, and Smooth Flush Decal Face Insert), nineteen sculpted multi-strand wrap-around 2x1 crown wigs (8 Hat-Ready with top 2x1 crown studs + 11 Sculpted-Top; every wig leaves a groove for the shared ear spot), seven wearable 2x1 crown hats, one-piece Party Headphones (human heads and short Hat-Ready wigs; prints upside down), Explorer Rucksack, Builder Spanner, Star Emblem Wand, Street Skateboard Deck, Seated Snap Legs, three stylized Pro vehicle wheels, and V2 modular rolling vehicle chassis with interchangeable snap-on body covers.

waves.name: Universal Flat-Pack Modular Craft (Cards A-D)
waves.scope: 19 parts (13 Snap Small, 6 Pro): 16 rigid flat-pack modular craft modules plus 3 smooth 0.80 mm PETG/TPU flex skins across Cards A-D (<= 170 x 170 mm), unlocking 9 canonical craft (Race Car, Dump Truck, Tractor, Trailer, Motorbike/Trike, Aeroplane, Catamaran, Helicopter, Space Shuttle) with 100% intact parts clearing the S1 small-parts cylinder.

waves.name: Progressive Power: Pro Steering & Momentum Cores (Cards E1-E2)
waves.scope: 32 parts (8 Snap Small, 24 Pro): captive Stage-2 Pro row-0 Ackermann rack steering linkage (bridge with fixed kingpins, rack guide and travel stop, rack, tall-tower knuckles with a barbed round wheel stub, the two free-hub front wheels (36 and 50 mm) that turn on it, tie-rod link, headed captive drive pins, steering column and wheel), rear dump-tub barrel hinge adapter, and positive-trail bike fork adapter, plus functional Stage-3 Momentum stored-energy propulsion and actuator modules (enclosed #64 band core with coaxial freewheel PTO gear, pawl spool, armed/pull-back latch and winding key, compliant bumper trigger, captive slam launcher, leak-free horizontal balloon jet + shutoff slide valve + 3-orifice nozzle selector, interleaved 10-deg hinged bellows clamshell, and un-jammed shrouded 42 mm vertical rip-cord turbine core) across Cards E1-E2 (<= 164 x 164 mm).

waves.name: Workshop Props
waves.scope: 15 parts (15 Pro): handheld workshop, kitchen and play props that clip onto Kip's Pro grip shaft in the hand port, in 5 Kip-Demo.html prop categories (with the 5 earlier props, 20 in all): Tools (Claw Hammer, Flat Screwdriver, Paint Roller), Cleaning (String Mop, Bristle Broom, Scrub Brush, Handheld Vacuum, Upright Vacuum), Cooking (Pancake Spatula, Frying Pan), Instruments (Acoustic Guitar, Brass Trumpet, Rattle Maraca) and Play (Swallow-Tail Flag, Magnifying Glass).

waves.name: Stage-4 Mech Drop-In Printable Robotics (Card F)
waves.scope: 11 parts (6 Snap Small, 5 Pro): PETG Stage-4 drop-in RC and robotics housings across Card F (<= 164 x 164 mm) coupling standard off-the-shelf N20 micro gearmotors, 9g micro servos (capturing the factory nylon horn with zero printed micro-splines), XIAO ESP32 / H-bridge electronics, and tool-locked 1S 602535 LiPo batteries onto the universal 12.5 mm craft keel with double-shear Pro pilot bearings.

waves.name: Construction: Road Roller and Dozer (Card G)
waves.scope: 3 parts (3 Pro): the construction-line parts across Card G (<= 164 x 164 mm): the 103.0 mm wide-track barbell axle, the 50.0 x 24.8 mm smooth dished road-roller drum and the 112.5 mm (9 TU) dozer axle, so a keel on two wide axles and four drums is a double-drum road roller (Gate G1 craft 10). A dozer's C-frame arms pivot on the same wide axle (docs/specs/construction-vehicles-spec.md).

families.block: Brick or plate: studs on top, socket underside. build: kind (brick|plate), grid [nx, ny].
families.tile: Flat top, socket underside only. build: grid.
families.slope: Female-only wedge with a 45 degree face on the standard foot. build: grid.
families.dome: Female-only dome on the standard foot. build: grid.
families.addon: Bespoke character shape with an integrated base: stud holes cut into its own underside (or a small pad). build: fn, grid, base, optional pad and lock.
families.capsule: Bespoke function shell with an integrated base. build: fn, grid, base, optional pad and lock.
families.forge_mount: Shared mount with a face option. build: fn, face, grid (reference grid).
families._note: A row without `build` is planned. Adding `build`, `type`, `behavior` and `tags` to a row registers it with the generator: one catalog row per new part.
families.racer: Racer set (Forge Club Month 1): car add-ons with integrated bases, plus a wheel set (axle block, wheel, axle). build: fn, grid, base, optional pad and lock.
families.robot: Snap robots: five slots that stack on studs (legs, torso, arms, head on the front row, back pack on the rear row). build: fn, grid, base integrated.
families.hair: Wrap-around 2x1 clip-on character wigs with cheek curtains, ear arches, nape skirt, and optional top 2x1 crown studs; prints upright sitting on its skirt rim. build: fn, grid, lock.
families.vehicle: Modular 12.5 mm TU vehicles and decks: recessed stud cockpits, Wave 6 Racer add-on ports, Pro steering bores and horizontal teardrop axle bores. build: fn, grid, base integrated, optional lock.
